{{External|rs|rsc}} {{otheruses|the entry-level [[ranged]] weapon|other uses|Crossbow (disambiguation)}} {{Infobox Item |name = Crossbow |image = [[File:Crossbow.png]] |release = [[4 January]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape beta is now online! |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wield, Drop |examine = This fires crossbow bolts. |value = 70 |weight = 8.000 |respawn = 500 |exchange = Yes |id = 837 }} [[File:Crossbow detail.png|left|130px]] The '''crossbow''' is the weakest type of [[Crossbow (weapon)|crossbow]], along with the [[Phoenix crossbow]], and requires a [[Ranged]] level of 1 to wield. It can only fire [[bronze bolts]] and [[mith grapple]]s. The crossbow and the bolts can be bought from [[Lowe's Archery Emporium]] in [[Varrock]]. There is a crossbow spawn in the [[Graveyard of Shadows]], [[Bone Yard]], and [[Hugor]]'s house at [[Land's End]] (south-west of the [[Kourend Woodland]]). It possesses the longest rapid-style attack range of any crossbow in the game, with 10 tiles. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = 0 |arange = +6 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = weapon |speed = 6 |attackrange = 10 |combatstyle = Crossbow |image = [[File:Crossbow equipped male.png|150px]] |altimage = [[File:Crossbow equipped female.png|140px]] }} {{CombatStyles|Crossbow|speed=6|attackrange=10}} ==Item sources== ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Crossbow}} ===Item spawns=== {{ItemSpawnTableHead}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Crossbow|location=[[Land's End]] - [[Hugor]]'s house|members=Yes|1512,3423|leagueRegion=Kourend}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Crossbow|location=[[Wilderness]] - [[Graveyard of Shadows]]|members=No|3174,3663|leagueRegion=Wilderness}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Crossbow|location=[[Wilderness]] - south-east of the [[Bone Yard]]|members=No|3284,3719|leagueRegion=Wilderness}} {{ItemSpawnTableBottom}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 7 July 2021 |update = Small Changes & Tweaks |poll = |change = The weapon's position on female players has been adjusted so that they appear to be equipped properly. }} {{Subject changes |daterange = 24 – 30 April 2007 |change = The item was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Crossbow (historical) detail.png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Crossbow detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Crossbow (historical).png|center]] |[[File:Crossbow.png|center]] |- |29 March 2004 ⁠–
